body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces a structured deployment environment matrix with multiple profiles (`thin_v1`, `full_rag`, `local`, `test`) and implements dedicated liveness (`/api/health`) and dependency-aware readiness (`/api/readiness`) endpoints. It also enhances the rate-limiting store to record operational state and enforce fail-closed behavior in multi-instance production environments, supported by updated preflight validation and secret scanning scripts. The review feedback suggests two key improvements: falling back to `getPreferredBackend()` in `recordOperationalState` to prevent the rate-limit store state from resolving to `null` during normal operations, and adding defensive null-checks when initializing the Supabase service client to gracefully handle uninitialized states instead of throwing raw `TypeError`s.
